//: Typecheck config for the agent-reply eval tool.
Neither repo typecheck gate covers tools/: tsconfig.build.json includes only
src/**, and the root tsconfig.json (the ratchet) includes src, tests, scripts
and *.config.ts. Vitest strips types without checking them. So this tool is
typechecked here, the same way tools/conversation-harness is:
It reaches into src/ only through the production modules it imports
(write-outcome, approval-chips, disclosure), which are checked transitively
against their real types, and into the harness scorer (dims, prompt-dims).
